slots.metaTitle: Anime Cabinet Refund Policy | Custom Portraits
slots.description: Read the Anime Cabinet refund policy for custom anime portraits, revisions, delays, undelivered orders and satisfaction concerns before commissioning your artwork.
slots.bodySections: [{"heading":"Our approach to custom portrait refunds","paragraphs":["Anime Cabinet creates each custom anime portrait by hand with a human artist. Because your artwork is made specifically from your instructions and reference photos, custom orders are not treated like mass-produced products. This Anime Cabinet refund policy explains when a refund may be available and how we handle revisions or delivery concerns.","We provide a preview within 72 hours under our standard service and include unlimited free revisions. Our goal is to resolve concerns by adjusting the artwork so it better matches your requested composition, likeness and chosen visual language. Our 24 anime and cartoon styles are fan-art inspired: you become an original character rather than a copyrighted character impersonation."]},{"heading":"Can I cancel if I change my mind?","paragraphs":["You may contact us as soon as possible if you change your mind about a cartoon portrait order. A cancellation or refund request is easiest to review before an artist has started work. Once the custom anime portrait commission has entered production, a refund may not be available because time has been spent creating artwork specifically for you.","If work has started, please do not place a second order or request a payment dispute before speaking with us. We will review the order status and explain the available options, which may include continuing with revisions where practical."]},{"heading":"Revisions and artwork concerns","paragraphs":["If you are not satisfied with your custom anime portrait from Anime Cabinet, request revisions rather than accepting an artwork you do not want. Unlimited free revisions are included, provided requests remain related to the original order and reference material. Tell us clearly what should change, such as hair, expression, clothing, colours, background or overall details.","A custom anime portrait from photo is an artistic interpretation, so exact photographic replication is not guaranteed. However, if the delivered preview does not reasonably follow your approved instructions or reference photos, contact us promptly. We will assess the concern and normally work with you on revisions before considering a refund."]},{"heading":"Delayed or undelivered portraits","paragraphs":["Standard previews are sent within 72 hours. If your preview or completed portrait is delayed beyond the stated timeframe, contact Anime Cabinet so we can check the order and provide an update. If an order is genuinely undelivered, we will investigate and work toward a replacement, completion or appropriate refund based on the circumstances.","This policy applies whether you order a digital portrait, custom anime portrait canvas or a commission online from Australia or elsewhere. Delivery concerns should be reported as soon as possible, especially where a physical product may be affected by an address or shipping issue."]},{"heading":"How to request a refund","paragraphs":["To request a refund under the Anime Cabinet refund policy, contact us with your order details and explain the reason for your request. Include any relevant reference images, preview feedback and messages so we can review the commission accurately. We assess requests individually, taking into account whether work has started, whether revisions were offered and whether the order was delivered as described.","Please remember that Anime Cabinet is a hand-drawn service, not a free photo-to-anime converter, automated filter or marketplace listing such as a custom anime portrait Etsy order. Our team will respond with the next available resolution for your specific commission."]},{"heading":"Frequently asked questions","paragraphs":["What is the Anime Cabinet refund policy for custom anime portrait commissions? Custom commissions may be refundable before production begins; after work starts, refunds are considered case by case. We generally offer revisions first because each portrait is made especially for the customer.","Can I request revisions instead of a refund? Yes. Unlimited free revisions are included, and revision requests are usually the best first step when artwork needs adjustments.","Does the policy cover delayed or undelivered portraits? Yes. Contact us promptly so we can investigate the order and determine whether completion, replacement or a refund is appropriate.","Are deposits refundable? If a deposit has been paid for a custom commission, its refundability depends on whether production has started and the order circumstances. Contact us before cancelling so we can review it."]}]
